parsed.rationale: Both participating records live inside test targets: one in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and the other in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`). Although the context flags do not set `is_test: true`, the file paths unambiguously place both declarations inside `Tests/` directories, making them test-fixture types. Each test file defines its own local `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.MockError` nested type to satisfy the needs of its own test suite; consolidating them would couple two independent test targets and risk leaking test-only mock semantics into shared production code. The duplication is intentional and load-bearing for test isolation.
